newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Acerinox 9-mo profit down 54.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Acerinox 9-mo profit down 54.74 pct.

text.p: Consolidated group results for Spanish steel producer Acerinox for the first nine months of 1996, in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE: The company said it had reached record production levels in all its plants.
But results had been hurt by an appreciation of the peseta against the European crosses and particularly against the mark, it said.
A mill closed due to a fire in June had restarted operations at the end of August, the company said.
Depreciation increased by 23 percent in the first nine months of the year, due to new investment and the company's practice of depreciating at the highest rates possible.
